executed_probe_identity.manifest_definition: SHA256 of compact sorted-key JSON mapping relative modified/untracked source filenames to file SHA256; probe entry uses executed source snapshot.

validation_source_difference: Executed source copied a Vec with to_vec; final Clippy-clean source moves that owned Vec into the same destination. The four deterministic probe tests passed on both versions. Probe remains uncommitted and is not included in the research PR.

environment.sdl_build: Release, HIDAPI on, tests and examples off; private prefix scoped per command
environment.steam_client_version_evidence: Previously supplied About Steam observation; not independently re-read during these runs
environment.access: Exact owned hidraw read/write open verified before consumer probes; existing access sufficed without new ACL or policy changes.
environment.steam_udev: steam-devices provides both USB-parent rules and a Valve HID-path rule that can match UHID.

procedure.invocation: cargo run --locked --example steam_uhid_probe --features experimental -- CASE SECONDS
procedure.sdl_phase: Steam exited before all three sequential runs; private SDL prefix and both helper executables scoped to each invocation.
procedure.steam_phase: Steam running and SDL helper unset; human listing answers obtained during the respective live cases.
procedure.reverse_protocol: Raw UHID FEATURE=0, OUTPUT=1, INPUT=2. Numbered feature SET validated; each request replied before next drain. Supported synthetic feature commands 83/87/ae; unsupported requests return -95 and malformed buffers -22. GET replies include one report ID.
procedure.cleanup: Normal completion closes consumer children and controller repeatedly, then verifies owned HID nodes disappear. Child guard kills/reaps its owned process group on error; fake-provider tests verify no pending request across polling.
procedure.private_artifacts: Only whitelisted reduced fields published; raw output, exact device nodes, process identity and logs retained privately.

retained_touch_result: Separate isolated DualSense SDL run passed three create/use/close iterations with touch down/move/up, motion, typed output feedback and removal.
limitations: No physical fidelity, full controls, gameplay or latency acceptance.
Neutral-only SDL diagnostics returned nonzero for missing changing sensor observations even when opened and neutral state were observed.
No exact input-report delivery instrumentation inside SDL or Steam; missing delivery observations remain unknown.
Lifecycle OPEN/CLOSE counts include instrumentation access and are not attributed to a particular consumer.
Lizard-disable detection identifies a setting command, not whether the kernel or userspace originated it.
The synthetic Steam feature response profile is limited; a negative client listing does not demonstrate a USB-topology requirement.
Puck topology explanation is source-supported, not a demonstrated runtime rejection reason.

Probe GET replies are short synthetic buffers: five bytes for empty identity/attributes and four for settings, unlike the padded 64-byte corpus identity/attribute fixtures. Negative Steam listing applies to this limited stub and does not reject a complete wired implementation.
tier_decision: linux.uhid.usb satisfies brief 03 wired criterion through observed kernel binding and SDL opening. Steam client compatibility and faithful Puck topology remain separate.
